Method of Attack: Uses benign apps as droppers to infect devices
Contacts remote command-and-control server to download and install secondary apps containing malware
Second-stage app disguised as system-level app
Uses fake security alerts to trick users into installing second app and granting admin rights
Shows intrusive ads on infected phones
Steals Facebook credentials by loading real Facebook login page inside native Android headless browser components (WebView, WebChromeClient) with malicious JavaScript to harvest credentials
Sends stolen credentials to remote server controlled by attackers
Attack Vector: Installation of benign dropper apps from Google Play Store
User tricked into installing second-stage app with admin rights
Indicators of Compromise: 53 apps removed from Google Play Store
Apps with Vietnamese language descriptions and communication with Vietnamese IP command-and-control servers
Malicious apps include flashlight apps, QR code scanners, compass apps, device optimization and cleaning apps
